Package simsgame.sims

Class Needs

java.lang.Object
simsgame.sims.Needs
public class Needs extends Object
Needs Class Manages physical and social requirements of Sim. Handles the calculation of average wellbeing, ensures stat values remain within valid boundaries Processes the natural decay of needs over time.

    • isCritical

      public boolean isCritical()
      Checks if individual need dropped to dangerous level. Need is considered critical if it is at or below 10.
      Returns:
      true if at least one need is 10 or lower, false otherwise.

    • decay

      public void decay(int hours)
      Passive reduction to all needs based on elapsed time. Different needs decay at different rates per hours.
      Parameters:
      hours - The number of simulation hours that have passed.
